boundary: One local Windows machine, AVR 1.8.6 / ESP32 3.3.6, released alpha.54 desktop with an isolated scheduler switch. Engine session clean is not an OS cold-cache measurement.
comparison: Wire project, add/remove SPI. Both routes re-run discovery. History restore explicitly disabled for attribution. Compare same-board same-source artifacts at identical absolute paths. No P95 or general cold-start claim.
exclusions: buffered-* is an independent rejected file-reading experiment; its optimization is not shipped. Matrix runs are correctness-only and were allowed to overlap packaging. All available timings, including slower runs, are retained.
